GPE.narrative: You are a group of 6 veterinary students visiting a wildlife sanctuary on an island. It is 1600 hours. A local boatman runs to you and says: 1. A tourist ferry has hit a rock 2 km offshore and is slowly sinking. 2. A batch of highly temperature-sensitive vaccines needs to be delivered to the mainland hospital (10 km away) before 1730 hours, or they will spoil. 3. A rare leopard has been severely injured by a poacher trap in the jungle 3 km inland. 4. A massive storm is predicted to hit the island at 1700 hours, which will stop all boat movement. You have one motorboat (seats 4), one jeep, basic medical kits, and ropes. The mainland police station is 12 km away. How will you coordinate your team to handle these critical emergencies before the storm hits?

GTO.PGT: Progressive Group Task: 4 progressive obstacles emphasizing balancing over narrow gaps. Resources: 1 long Plank, 1 short Balli, 2 Ropes. Time: 45 mins. Strict 'no touching red' rules.
GTO.HGT: Half Group Task: 1 complex obstacle involving a suspended drum. Resources: 1 Plank, 1 Balli, 1 Rope. Time: 15 mins.
GTO.IO: Individual Obstacles: 10 obstacles (High Jump, Double Ditch, Zig-Zag Balance, Tarzan Swing, Commando Walk, Tiger Leap, Rope Climbing, Screen Jump, Burma Bridge, Monkey Crawl). Time: 3 mins.
GTO.FGT: Final Group Task: 1 long, complex obstacle requiring the entire group to extract a 'hostage' dummy from a confined space using limited ropes. Resources: Plank, Balli, 3 Ropes. Time: 15 mins.
